reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 9 points better, in a game of about 222 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 4 points towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Grizzlies (confidence).
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 68 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 196 and 244 total points.
